full.en: Bio ENERGY Supergreens 150g. A green blend of superfoods with guarana, which helps you to feel more energetic. High caffeine content (27,5 mg / 100 mL). Consumption is not recommended for children, pregnant women and nursing mothers. Ingredients: Lucuma (pouteria lucuma)*, hemp protein (cannabis sativa)*, barley grass (hordeum vulgare)*, wheat grass (triticum aestivum)*, chlorella (chlorella vulgaris)*, matcha (Japanese green tea) (lepidium meyenii)*, guarana (paullinia cupana)*, lemon flavour. *organic. Usage: Mix 1 teaspoon (5 g) of powder in 100 mL of water and mix well. Storage: Dry and cool place.
